title: WHY ARE MEMORY STOCKS CRASHING RIGHT NOW?!
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: KOSPI/SK Hynix sell-off on oversupply and cheap Chinese memory competition is driving memory names lower; same story as last week.
Unverified rumor, treated as noise for markets.

calls.reason: Intraday overbought reversal (he shorted), then bought the dip at ~901 and carried a small long overnight; larger time frames oversold, so long makes more sense than short.
calls.quote: I still said it made more sense to go long than to go short, especially at these oversold levels on the larger time frames

calls.reason: Nasdaq still technically oversold at the 700 support range; warns it can get worse before better.
calls.quote: if we look at the overall Nasdaq market, still technically kind of oversold and still at that 700 support range

notes: 'Happy Monday', SpaceX/Netflix earnings 'tomorrow' => Mon Oct 19 evening. MU levels '9:08, 9:07... 9:01' read as $908/$907/$901 (transcription). SK Hynix called fundamentally cheap (5.7 P/E) but no trade view; skipped.
